title: ODOC-437 slice 4: resume retrieval from artifact references -- exact-section reads and digest reuse (AC4)
description:
ODOC-437 slice 4. Advances AC4.

Per the spec and the leader ruling (Q3): lore does NOT own the checkpoint format -- the phase handoff (outcome, revisions, artifact references, acceptance evidence, unresolved issues, next phase) is validated by the CONTROLLER, which is opum-cli -- and it is NOT the opum-handoff cursor. The lore-cli share of AC4 is RESUMING RETRIEVAL from artifact references: exact-section reads by concept and anchor, and digest reuse, with NO whole-history load. Size this slice to exactly that.

If it turns out to need a format lore must own, REPORT IT before building (leader instruction).

Companion criteria from the spec: CTX-09 (bounded diagnostics retain decisive failures and offer hash-verified exact reads) and CTX-10 (checkpoint/resume preserves unresolved criteria and citations without importing the preceding transcript). Depends on Slice 2 (LCLI-681).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Retrieval resumes from artifact references: exact-section reads by concept and anchor, plus digest reuse, with no whole-history load.
No checkpoint format owned by lore is introduced; if one proves necessary it is reported before it is built.
